regions.name: The Fallen Courtyard
regions.blurb: The gate of a fortress nobody has garrisoned in centuries. Morning still comes here. Nothing else does.

stages.prompt: The outer wall has fallen in on itself. Something in garrison plate still walks its rounds.

options.label: The Breach
options.hint: Steel scrapes on stone ahead.

stages.prompt: Beyond the rubble the path divides.

options.label: The Guardhouse
options.hint: A door hangs from one hinge.

options.label: The Rampart Stair
options.hint: A longer way, and watched.

stages.prompt: A banner still flies on the barbican. Someone is standing under it, at attention.

options.label: The Barbican
options.hint: Light on his feet. He salutes first.

stages.prompt: A winch-house stands beside the inner gate. Its chain is rusted but whole.

options.label: Turn the Winch
options.hint: The gate would stay open behind you.

options.label: The Well
options.hint: Something glints below the waterline.

stages.prompt: The gate passage. It is narrow, and it is occupied.

options.label: The Gate Passage
options.hint: He fills it wall to wall.

options.label: The Murder Hole
options.hint: A ladder up, behind a loose stone.

stages.prompt: A chapel alcove survives against the keep wall. A single candle burns.

options.label: Kneel
options.hint: Rest a moment. Wounds close.

stages.prompt: The inner ward. He is standing exactly where he was posted.

options.label: The Inner Ward
options.hint: Embers drift from the gatehouse.

regions.name: The Blackwood
regions.blurb: The royal hunting forest. The trees grew in over the road, and over the hunters.

stages.prompt: The road gives out under roots. Lanterns hang in the branches, still lit.

options.label: The Lantern Road
options.hint: Someone is keeping them lit.

stages.prompt: A deer trail leaves the road. The road goes on.

options.label: The Road
options.hint: Hoofprints, then bootprints.

options.label: The Deer Trail
options.hint: White antlers move between the trunks.

stages.prompt: Briars have been woven across the way. Not by the wind.

options.label: The Briar Gate
options.hint: Two blades part the thorns from inside.

options.label: The Hollow Oak
options.hint: Wide enough to hide a man. Or his things.

stages.prompt: A ravine. A bridge of rope lies coiled on your side of it.

options.label: Cast the Bridge
options.hint: It will hold. It will also remain.

options.label: The Charcoal Burner's Hut
options.hint: The door is barred from outside.

stages.prompt: The trees here have been cut and stacked, very neatly, for a very long time.

options.label: The Woodpile
options.hint: The woodcutter is still at work.

stages.prompt: A gibbet tree, and beneath it a spring.

options.label: Drink
options.hint: The water is cold and clean.

options.label: Under the Gibbet
options.hint: The hanged have dropped their purses.

stages.prompt: A clearing of stumps. Every one has been used as a block.

options.label: The Clearing
options.hint: A cleaver drags somewhere in the dark.

regions.name: The Cathedral of Ash
regions.blurb: A cathedral raised over a research works. Someone burned it to keep what was underneath. It is still burning.

stages.prompt: Pilgrims' steps, worn into bowls. Ash falls like first snow.

options.label: The Pilgrim Stair
options.hint: Robed figures turn toward you.

stages.prompt: A censer the size of a bell swings across the porch, and a knight swings it.

options.label: The Porch
options.hint: Slow. Do not mistake that for safe.

options.label: The Almoner's Box
options.hint: Chained to the wall. The chain is ash.

stages.prompt: At the great doors, a woman in red is waiting. She has been waiting a long time.

options.label: The Cathedral Steps
options.hint: Two blades. No hesitation.

stages.prompt: Inside, the nave is open to the sky. A side door leads to the sacristy.

options.label: Unbar the Sacristy
options.hint: A way in that avoids the steps.

options.label: The Reliquary
options.hint: Saints' bones, and what was buried with them.

stages.prompt: The choir is still singing. There is nothing left of them to sing with.

options.label: The Choir Loft
options.hint: It reaches for you with the hymn.

stages.prompt: Votive candles, hundreds, none burned down.

options.label: Light One
options.hint: Warmth without smoke.

stages.prompt: The bell tower has fallen through the crossing. Something has made its den in the bronze.

options.label: The Crossing
options.hint: The bell tolls by itself.

regions.name: The Sunken Crypt
regions.blurb: Not a burial place. The minds the Crown stored were kept here, and then the river was let in.

stages.prompt: Stairs descend into black water. Lamps burn beneath its surface.

options.label: The Drowned Stair
options.hint: A squire, still carrying his lord's shield.

stages.prompt: The ossuary. Skulls are stacked to the vault.

options.label: The Ossuary
options.hint: One niche is sealed with newer mortar.

options.label: The Processional
options.hint: Heavy footfalls in the water.

stages.prompt: Something pale is pressed against a tomb lid, drinking what seeps out.

options.label: The Weeping Tomb
options.hint: It turns. It is not finished.

stages.prompt: A sluice wheel. Turning it would drain the lower halls.

options.label: Open the Sluice
options.hint: The water would not come back.

options.label: The Dry Niche
options.hint: A saint's alcove above the waterline.

stages.prompt: With the water gone, a lower door stands revealed.

options.label: The Royal Vault
options.hint: Sealed since before the flood.

options.label: The Gallery of Kings
options.hint: Their effigies have been defaced.

stages.prompt: A reliquary lamp, lit, in a room with no door but the one you came by.

options.label: Sit by the Lamp
options.hint: It asks nothing.

stages.prompt: The oldest tomb. Its keeper has not left his post.

options.label: The First Tomb
options.hint: A lantern, held very still.

regions.name: The Wyrm's Roost
regions.blurb: A volcanic fortress. Under it they kept a thing built to break sieges, and never told it the wars were over.

stages.prompt: The cliff road. The stone is glazed, as if it ran once.

options.label: The Glass Road
options.hint: A knight in scale. Not his own.

stages.prompt: The falconry, roofless. The perches are man-height.

options.label: The Mews
options.hint: He whistles. Nothing comes. He draws instead.

options.label: The Tack Room
options.hint: Harness for something with a long neck.

stages.prompt: Bones, heaped. Among them something small is learning to hunt.

options.label: The Boneyard
options.hint: Small for a dragon. Not small.

stages.prompt: A chain as thick as a tree runs down the cliff to the valley, with a cage on it.

options.label: Free the Counterweight
options.hint: The cage would ride up and down at your word.

options.label: The Keeper's Cell
options.hint: He locked himself in. It did not help.

stages.prompt: The egg chamber. The shells are old. One is not.

options.label: The Clutch
options.hint: Warm ash, and something under it.

options.label: The Brood Guard
options.hint: Two knights swore to guard the clutch. One is left.

stages.prompt: A spring runs hot from the rock. Someone cut a basin for it.

options.label: Bathe Your Hands
options.hint: Heat without harm.

stages.prompt: The summit. The sky is very large here, and part of it is looking at you.

options.label: The Summit
options.hint: A shadow crosses the sun, and comes back.

regions.name: The Frozen Citadel
regions.blurb: The mountain fortress. Its king had the gates frozen shut, and himself with them.

stages.prompt: The pass. Soldiers stand in ranks along it, upright, rimed white.

options.label: The Frozen Rank
options.hint: One of them is breathing.

stages.prompt: The curtain wall, sheathed in ice.

options.label: The Wall Walk
options.hint: A duellist practises alone, as he has for an age.

options.label: The Armoury
options.hint: The racks are frozen solid.

stages.prompt: Below the keep, a pit. A chain runs down into it, and the chain is moving.

options.label: The Kennel Stair
options.hint: A thrall bars the way down.

options.label: The Pit
options.hint: Whatever is on the chain has heard you.

stages.prompt: A counterweight lift, iced into its shaft.

options.label: Break the Ice
options.hint: It would run from the pass to the keep.

options.label: The Brazier
options.hint: Someone kept one fire alive.

stages.prompt: The great stair. Halfway up it, a shape that was part of the wall steps out.

options.label: The Great Stair
options.hint: The air itself resists you.

stages.prompt: The queen's solar. Frost flowers cover every pane.

options.label: The Solar
options.hint: A jewel case, frozen shut.

options.label: The Window Seat
options.hint: The view is all white. It is restful.

stages.prompt: The hall of the winter throne.

options.label: The Winter Throne
options.hint: He has not moved in an age. He moves now.

regions.name: The Hollow Deep
regions.blurb: Under the throne is where the Crown sent what it had no use for. All of it is still down there, together.

stages.prompt: The stair goes down past where stairs should stop. People stand along it, facing the wall.

options.label: The Long Stair
options.hint: One turns. There is no one in it.

stages.prompt: A gallery of names, carved floor to roof. Most have been licked smooth.

options.label: The Gallery of Names
options.hint: It is eating one now. It looks up.

options.label: The Unread Wall
options.hint: A few names survive. Something was hidden behind them.

stages.prompt: The dark here has a grain to it, like wood. Like something growing.

options.label: The Grain
options.hint: It comes apart from the dark as it moves.

stages.prompt: A second stair, unlit, climbing. It smells of candle smoke — the sanctuary's.

options.label: Mark the Way
options.hint: You could find this from above.

options.label: The Last Candle
options.hint: Someone carried it this far.

stages.prompt: A hall where oaths were sworn. The banners hang empty; the words are gone out of them.

options.label: The Oath Hall
options.hint: It has eaten promises. It is very strong.

options.label: The Reliquary of Vows
options.hint: One vow, kept, in a lead box.

stages.prompt: Stillness. A place it has already emptied, and so does not visit.

options.label: Rest in the Emptied Place
options.hint: Nothing here wants anything.

stages.prompt: The bottom. It is not dark. It is occupied.

options.label: The Bottom
options.hint: It says a name. It might be yours.

regions.name: The Hollow Throne
regions.blurb: The last hall, and the machine at the end of it. Somebody stayed to keep it running.

stages.prompt: The royal mile. Statues of every monarch, each with the face struck off.

options.label: The Royal Mile
options.hint: The honour guard still stands.

stages.prompt: The antechamber, hung with banners gone to thread.

options.label: The Antechamber
options.hint: The king's own blade. He bows.

options.label: The Treasury
options.hint: Open. Unguarded. Nearly empty.

stages.prompt: A figure sits on the steps with a crown in its lap, turning it over and over.

options.label: The Steps
options.hint: It was a king. It has forgotten which.

stages.prompt: A small door behind the arras, for the king's private use.

options.label: Unlock the King's Door
options.hint: Kings do not use the front.

options.label: The Chapel Royal
options.hint: The last quiet place.

stages.prompt: The last guard. He has not been relieved. He does not expect to be.

options.label: The Last Post
options.hint: He raises his sword like a man lifting a door.

options.label: Behind the Throne
options.hint: Where a king hides what matters.

stages.prompt: The throne room doors. They are open. They have always been open.

options.label: Steady Yourself
options.hint: Breathe.

options.label: The Roof of the Hall
options.hint: Something vast is folded up among the rafters. It has been listening.

stages.prompt: The Hollow Throne.

options.label: The Hollow Throne
options.hint: The crown turns toward you.
